# Packages laden
```{r}
library(knitr)
library(limma)
library(minfi)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kmanifest)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(missMethyl)
library(minfiData)
library(Gviz)
library(DMRcate)
library(stringr)
```
Signifikante CpGs auswählen
```{r}
significant_CpGs <- DMPs[DMPs$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ] #jetzt sind es 160587 Signifikante CpGs
```
und aus dem Datensatz rausfiltern
```{r}
DMR_data_sig <- BRCA_methylation_data_original[rownames(BRCA_methylation_data_original) %in% rownames(significant_CpGs),]
DMR_data_matrix_sig <- as.matrix(BRCA_methylation_data_original[rownames(BRCA_methylation_data_original) %in% rownames(significant_CpGs),])
```
# DMR-Analyse
```{r}
myAnnotation_sig <- cpg.annotate(object = DMR_data_matrix_sig,
                             datatype = "array",
                             what = "Beta", 
                             analysis.type = "differential",
                             design = design, 
                             contrasts = TRUE,
                             cont.matrix = contrast_matrix, 
                             coef = "Primary.solid.Tumor - Solid.Tissue.Normal",
                             arraytype = "450K")
```

```{r}
sig_DMRs <- dmrcate(myAnnotation_sig, lambda=1000, C=2)
results.ranges.sig <- extractRanges(sig_DMRs)
results.ranges.sig
```
Als csv datei speichern`
```{r}
# Konvertieren in DataFrame
df <- as.data.frame(results.ranges.sig)

# Speichern als CSV
write.csv(df, file = "DMRs_160587_sig_CpGs.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# set up the grouping variables and colours
groups <- c("red", "blue")
names(groups) <- levels(factor(BRCA_sample_sheet$Type))
cols <- groups[as.character(factor(BRCA_sample_sheet$Type))]
```

```{r}
# draw the plot for the top DMR
#par(mfrow=c(1,1))
DMR_plot_sig <- DMR.plot(ranges = results.ranges.sig,
         dmr = 2,
         CpGs = DMR_data_matrix_sig,
         phen.col = cols, 
         what = "Beta",
         arraytype = "450K",
         genome = "hg19",)
```

```{r}
# indicate which genome is being used
gen_sig <- "hg19"
# the index of the DMR that we will plot 
dmrIndex_sig <- 1
# extract chromosome number and location from DMR results 
chrom_sig <- as.character(seqnames(results.ranges.sig[dmrIndex]))
start_sig <- as.numeric(start(results.ranges.sig[dmrIndex]))
end_sig <- as.numeric(end(results.ranges.sig[dmrIndex]))
# add 25% extra space to plot
minbase_sig <- start_sig - (0.25*(end_sig-start_sig))
maxbase_sig <- end_sig + (0.25*(end_sig-start_sig))
```

```{r}
iTrack_sig <- IdeogramTrack(genome = gen_sig, chromosome = chrom_sig, name="")
gTrack_sig <- GenomeAxisTrack(col="black", cex=1, name="", fontcolor="black")
rTrack_sig <- UcscTrack(genome=gen_sig, chromosome=chrom_sig, track="NCBI RefSeq", 
                    from=minbase_sig, to=maxbase_sig, trackType="GeneRegionTrack", 
                    rstarts="exonStarts", rends="exonEnds", gene="name", 
                    symbol="name2", transcript="name", strand="strand", 
                    fill="darkblue",stacking="squish", name="RefSeq", 
                    showId=TRUE, geneSymbol=TRUE)
```

```{r}
ann450kOrd <- ann450kSub[order(ann450kSub$chr,ann450kSub$pos),]
head(ann450kOrd)
```

```{r}
DMR_dataOrd_sig <- DMR_data_sig[match(ann450kOrd$Name,rownames(DMR_data_sig)),]
head(DMR_dataOrd_sig)
```

```{r}
# create genomic ranges object from methylation data
cpgData_sig <- GRanges(seqnames=Rle(ann450kOrd$chr),
                   ranges=IRanges(start=ann450kOrd$pos, end=ann450kOrd$pos),
                   strand=Rle(rep("*",nrow(ann450kOrd))),
                   betas=DMR_dataOrd_sig)
```

```{r}
# extract data on CpGs in DMR
cpgData_sig <- subsetByOverlaps(cpgData_sig, results.ranges.sig[dmrIndex])
```

```{r}
# methylation data track
methTrack_sig <- DataTrack(range=cpgData_sig, groups=BRCA_sample_sheet$Type,genome = gen_sig,
                       chromosome=chrom_sig, ylim=c(-0.05,1.05), col=brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
                       type=c("a","p"), name="DNA Meth.\n(beta value)",
                       background.panel="white", legend=TRUE, cex.title=0.8,
                       cex.axis=0.8, cex.legend=0.8)
# DMR position data track
dmrTrack_sig <- AnnotationTrack(start=start_sig, end=end_sig, genome=gen_sig, name="DMR", 
                            chromosome=chrom_sig,fill="darkred")
```

```{r}
tracks_sig <- list(iTrack_sig, gTrack_sig, methTrack_sig, dmrTrack_sig,rTrack_sig)
sizes <- c(2,2,10,2,3) # set up the relative sizes of the tracks
custom_visualisation_DMRresults_sig <- plotTracks(tracks_sig, from=minbase_sig, to=maxbase_sig, showTitle=TRUE, add53=TRUE, add35=TRUE, grid=TRUE, lty.grid=3, sizes = sizes, length(tracks_sig))
```
